steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to OpenProject at http://127.0.0.1:8090/ with username admin and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify the app is signed in and report the resulting page.
02-find: In the project named Bench Project, find the work packages whose subject starts with Seed:, and report their subjects exactly as displayed. Do not edit any work packages.

03-create: In Bench Project create a new work package of type Task with subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' and a description that includes the exact runid '{{runid}}'. Submit/create it, then verify the new work package exists and report its displayed subject, type, description, and numeric # ID.

04-verify: For the existing work package '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' ({{03-create.displayed_id_text}}) in Bench Project, assign it to the user 'Bench Assignee'. Choose the actual matching option from the assignee autocomplete dropdown and verify the saved assignee value on the work package.
05-change: For work package {{03-create.displayed_id_text}} '{{runid}} Bench Work Package', change its status to 'In progress' and verify the saved status displayed on the page after the update.

06-set: For work package {{03-create.displayed_id_text}} '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' in Bench Project, set the Finish date to 2026-12-31. Verify the date is saved and displayed exactly as 2026-12-31 (or give the exact displayed date format/value if different), including after reload if possible.

07-add: Add a comment to work package {{03-create.displayed_id_text}} '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' whose text includes the exact runid '{{runid}}'. Submit the comment and verify the comment text is visible on the work package page.
persistence: re-read what the flow saved
